items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Bertell Knox is a local drummer... He showed up, and it's very good to work with someone like that.

ctx.x: Blues Alley is a jazz club in Washington, D.C.?

Right. It would be Tommy's group. So when I do the jazz festival, I always like to work with Tommy and Johnny Eaton, and, of course, Bill Goodall, and whatever drummer is available. So -- Steve Jordan is a very good guitarist. He's from one of the big bands in the old era. He's a guitarist and he sings. But he's very good and he's got a very good sense of rhythm. Bertell Knox is a local drummer. I think he was out with Ella on tour for a long time. He's a very good man on brushes. He showed up, and it's very good…
